evals.prompt: Plan an authorized security assessment of checkout staging rc-18 from its threat model and ASVS requirements.
assertions: Pins authorization, target and build, accounts, time, techniques, exclusions, safety limits, contacts, data handling, stop conditions, and recovery
Derives risk-based coverage from threats, trust boundaries, change impact, and explicitly versioned applicable requirements
Combines complementary techniques and documents their blind spots instead of relying on one scanner or penetration test

evals.prompt: Triage scanner, code-review, and manual API-test results into security findings.
assertions: Validates and classifies results instead of reporting every tool alert as a vulnerability
Records exact revision, preconditions, minimal reproduction, impact, exposure, controls, severity rationale, confidence, and redacted evidence
Protects sensitive evidence and separates confirmed findings, validation needs, false positives, and residual-risk decisions

evals.prompt: Retest the fix for a cross-tenant authorization vulnerability.
assertions: Pins the remediation revision and repeats the original reproduction with the authorized accounts and environment
Tests adjacent read, list, mutation, role, identifier, and regression paths for bypasses
Reports remediation state, updated evidence, limitations, and residual risk without accepting risk or approving release
